messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks to you, {04 1f 00},
I'm good as new!

{07 07 00}If it weren't for you, I
might've never been able to
eat again!
{07 14 00}I should give you something
for saving my life,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tänu sinule, {04 1f 00},
olen jälle nagu uus!

{07 07 00}Kui sind poleks olnud, ei
oleks ma ehk enam kunagi
süüa saanud!
{07 14 00}Peaksin sulle midagi andma
mu elu päästmise eest,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, your tender
care has returned me
to full health!
{07 19 00}I can really count on you{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Thanks for attending to me
in my time of plague!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sinu hell
hoolitsus on mu
täielikult terveks teinud!
{07 19 00}Sinu peale võib loota{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Aitäh, et hoolitsesid minu
eest katkuajal!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, come to think of it...{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}My cold's all gone now!
{07 00 00}That {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00} really worked!
{07 14 00}Thanks for everything,
buddy!

I want to give you
something for bringing me
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, kui järele mõelda...{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Mu külmetus on nüüd läbi!
{07 00 00}See {ff 00 00 07}rohi{ff 00 00 00} tõesti mõjus!
{07 14 00}Aitäh kõige eest,
semu!

Tahan sulle midagi anda
selle eest, et tõid mulle
{ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
